canonical_title: OpenAI to end model-supply agreement with Cursor after SpaceX acquisition
treatment: Covered as the August 29 decision to wind down OpenAI model supply to Cursor following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX. Repeat only for a changed shutoff date, a replacement model-supply agreement, a material change to Cursor model availability, or a formal response that changes the practical impact.
known_facts: OpenAI notified SpaceX that it intends to wind down its contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor.
OpenAI proposed November 12, 2026 as the shutoff date and said this is the maximum notice period under the contract.
OpenAI said it is not confident SpaceX would use its technology within OpenAI's terms of service.
OpenAI said its change-of-control clause gives it a limited cancellation window after Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX.
OpenAI said it will not provide future models to Cursor during the wind-down and specifically cited increased accountability around Astra.
reinclude_only_if: OpenAI, Cursor, or SpaceX changes or cancels the November 12 shutoff plan.
Cursor announces a replacement agreement or material change in access to OpenAI models.
A future OpenAI model, including Astra, becomes available to Cursor despite the announced restriction.
A formal legal, contractual, or product response materially changes the practical interpretation.
notes: Reuters published at 02:01 UTC (11:01 JST) on August 29, inside the 2026-08-29 Midday Brief window.
